extract_pts_feat: extract point cloud features by voxelizing points and encoding through the backbone network
forward_pts_train: run the forward training pass for the point cloud branch and compute detection losses
simple_test_pts: run inference on point cloud features and return 3D bounding box predictions
aug_test_pts: test point cloud branch with augmentation by merging flipped and scaled feature outputs
aug_test: run augmented testing on point cloud data and return merged 3D bounding box results
